patthana23.13:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo hīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.13:2.1: na kusalaṃ na majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.13:3.1: na kusalaṃ paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha. na kusalaṃ na micchattaniyataṃ
